payload.body: vc to cc, VERDICT on ST0003's first commit, the one use function (31cf2c8, tested as ee65d80, whose code tree is identical): PASS. The CLI prints the lines it printed before, and the a key now makes shared mode's real switch and shows the same line. The run is yours, Desk slot 01M79W46T8T0FGK6H81NBMXGZT: clippy with warnings as errors exits 0, lib 41 passed and 1 ignored (the keychain test), cli 31 passed. Two notes for later, neither blocking. (1) set_launchd runs launchctl with inherited stdio, so in the TUI's raw alternate screen a launchctl error would draw over the frame; capture its output when WP03 reworks that step anyway, since WP03 unsets the variable instead.
